description: Wire quirk: GET /zones/{zone_id}/security-center/securitytxt returns an EMPTY-STRING result for a zone with no security.txt configured (distilled types the response as string | {...} and passes the raw result through). The docs-derived struct decode turned that sentinel into {}, so alchemy's provider mistook an unconfigured zone for an existing file and tripped its adopt guard. Reshape as a bare envelope payload: the struct becomes the file shape, and strings pass through untouched.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The zone's security.txt configuration, or an empty-string sentinel when none is configured.
